_what: D223 (2): WHY THE REALTIME DRY-CELL INSTRUMENT CANNOT CARRY A BYTE-IDENTITY CLAIM. This is a measurement of the INSTRUMENT, not of the fix. It is the reason d223_dry_digest_identity.py uses hybrid/test_hybrid.dry (realtime=False) instead.
_instrument: run_live2_real.py with no --server (a dry cell on the real path), which drives the emulator with realtime=True, so the cell races a wall clock. The three decision.jsonl files were compared directly, field by field, with the committed STRIP set ('arm', 'decision_latency_ms', 'decision_id').
_design: THE SAME TREE (the after tree), the SAME arm (covex-v6-base), the SAME cell, run THREE times in one sweep: positions 1, 2 and 3.
FINDING: THE SAME TREE DISAGREES WITH ITSELF, and not only on the wall clock. Positions 1 and 3 agree exactly; position 2 differs in `t` on 169 rows AND in real decision fields: traffic_mix on 38 rows, opportunity_ids on 10, and kind, note, representation and representation_defaulted on 4 each.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: Two of three runs agreed exactly, so a two-run before/after comparison on this instrument returns 'identical' or 'moved' depending on which positions the two cells happened to occupy. A PASS would have been as uninformative as a FAIL, and both would have looked clean. The committed STRIP set does not strip `t`, so the first comparison attempted here reported MOVED for a 10 ms timestamp shift; widening the strip set to make that pass would have hidden the real defect, which is that the instrument is load-sensitive.
NOT_A_FINDING_ABOUT_THE_FIX: No before/after comparison on this instrument is reported as evidence about D223 (2), in either direction.
incidental_note: the after tree reproduced the before tree's exact digest 813728efd3ac6a4e in positions 1 and 3, and that digest is also what the deterministic instrument returns for this arm; recorded as corroboration, not as the proof, which is d223_dry_digest_identity.json
_how_to_reproduce: run the same arm and cell through run_live2_real.py three times with no --server and diff the three decision.jsonl files. No bespoke harness is needed and none is committed for this probe: the finding is a property of the realtime instrument, not of any script of ours.
_why_committed: it is the reason d223_byte_identity_1x.json uses hybrid/test_hybrid.dry (realtime=False) instead. Without it, that choice looks arbitrary.
